## Summary of Changes

### Bug Description
The "Copy Url" feature produced invalid, duplicated URLs like:
```
https://www.youtube.com/https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCKvfzCyVQPe2IYg4PkugvWQ
```

### Root Cause
In three locations, `YouTubeChannel` objects were being created with a full uploader URL (e.g., `https://www.youtube.com/channel/XXX`) instead of just the channel ID. When `getChannelUrl()` was called, it passed this full URL to `YoutubeChannelLinkHandlerFactory.getInstance().getUrl(getId())`, which then constructed a malformed URL by prepending `https://www.youtube.com/` to an already-absolute URL.

### Files Modified

**1. `app/src/main/java/free/rm/skytube/businessobjects/YouTube/newpipe/NewPipeService.java`**
- Added `getChannelIdFromUrl(String uploaderUrl)` helper method that extracts the channel ID from a full channel URL using `streamingService.getChannelLHFactory().getId()`
- Modified `getDetails()` to call this helper instead of passing `extractor.getUploaderUrl()` directly

**2. `app/src/main/java/free/rm/skytube/businessobjects/YouTube/newpipe/VideoPager.java`**
- Added `getChannelId(String uploaderUrl)` helper method that extracts the channel ID using the existing `channelLinkHandler`
- Modified `convert()` to call this helper instead of passing `item.getUploaderUrl()` directly

**3. `app/src/main/java/free/rm/skytube/businessobjects/YouTube/newpipe/VideoPagerWithChannel.java`**
- Added `getChannelId(String uploaderUrl)` helper method (same approach as VideoPager)
- Modified `convert()` to call this helper instead of passing `item.getUploaderUrl()` directly

### Key Code Change Pattern
```java
// Before (buggy):
new YouTubeChannel(extractor.getUploaderUrl(), extractor.getUploaderName())

// After (fixed):
String channelId = getChannelIdFromUrl(extractor.getUploaderUrl());
new YouTubeChannel(channelId, extractor.getUploaderName())
```

The `getChannelIdFromUrl` / `getChannelId` methods use NewPipe's `ChannelLinkHandlerFactory.getId()` to properly extract the raw channel ID from any URL format (e.g., `https://www.youtube.com/channel/XXX`, `channel/XXX`, or raw `XXX`).
